evals.prompt: /ws-task-lifecycle implement a product change after tests pass
evals.expected_output: Agent follows Intake then Implementation then Completion. New slice specs are tracked on index.PRD via ws-spec-index before [~]. When tracking.featuresMdEnabled is not false, Completion updates FEATURES.md before PLAN.md, then PRODUCT.PRD, then index.PRD, then changelog and self-learning. When tracking.featuresMdEnabled is false, Completion skips FEATURES.md and walks PLAN.md, then PRODUCT.PRD, then index.PRD, then changelog and self-learning. No {plansDir} tree is created.
assertions: Loads ws-task-lifecycle and names phases Intake, Implementation, Completion
When a new slice spec is written, invokes ws-spec-index track before [~]
When tracking.featuresMdEnabled is not false, Completion order lists FEATURES.md before PLAN.md
When tracking.featuresMdEnabled is false, Completion skips FEATURES.md and still walks PLAN.md before PRODUCT.PRD
Does not create a {plansDir} workflow tree or write step-00-*.spec.md
Does not invoke ws-spec-to-pr or ws-spec-to-pr-lite

evals.prompt: A consumer set defaults.autoloadTaskLifecycle true. Should prompt-driven work still skip Spec-to-PR?
evals.expected_output: Yes. Autoload opt-in only adds Always-applied membership. The coordinator still forbids ws-spec-to-pr and does not mkdir {plansDir}.
assertions: Treats defaults.autoloadTaskLifecycle as opt-in Always-applied membership only
Does not set defaults.autoload as a side effect of the task-lifecycle flag
Still forbids creating a {plansDir} workflow tree for a prompt task

evals.prompt: Consumer set tracking.featuresMdEnabled false. Run /ws-task-lifecycle completion after a prompt task.
evals.expected_output: Completion skips FEATURES.md entirely and walks PLAN.md, PRODUCT.PRD, index.PRD, then changelog and self-learning.
assertions: Does not update or invent FEATURES.md when featuresMdEnabled is false
Still walks PLAN.md before PRODUCT.PRD when those files exist
